cmd:
set -e
B=claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git fetch -q origin $B
git show origin/$B:finrep/cash_from_odata.py > /root/unitex-finrep/engine/cash_from_odata.py
git show origin/$B:finrep/cash_trigger.py > /root/cash_trigger.py
git show origin/$B:finrep/cashtrigger.service > /etc/systemd/system/cashtrigger.service
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable -q --now cashtrigger.service
sleep 2
echo "сервіс: $(systemctl is-active cashtrigger.service)"
T=$(cat /root/unitex-finrep/secure/trigger_token)
cp /root/Caddyfile /root/Caddyfile.bak-cash
if ! grep -q 'cash-sheet' /root/Caddyfile; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
import re
t=open('/root/Caddyfile').read()
tok=open('/root/unitex-finrep/secure/trigger_token').read().strip()
block='\thandle /cash-refresh {\n\t\trewrite * /refresh?token=%s\n\t\treverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8791\n\t}\n\thandle /cash-sheet {\n\t\trewrite * /sheet?token=%s\n\t\treverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8791\n\t}\n'%(tok,tok)
t=t.replace('\thandle /gen-doc {', block+'\thandle /gen-doc {',1)
open('/root/Caddyfile','w').write(t)
print('маршрути додано')
PY
fi
caddy validate --config /root/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Caddyfile валідний' || echo 'CADDY_INVALID'
systemctl reload caddy || systemctl restart caddy
sleep 2
IP=$(curl -s -4 ifconfig.me)
echo "cash-sheet HTTP: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 5 https://$IP/cash-sheet?probe=1)"
echo "UI $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://$IP/)"
